scope.summary: Design-spike/prototype contract for virtual materialization from content-addressed WorkAreaTree records to reversible materialized file views.
scope.claim_boundary: Metadata-only design spike/prototype. No native SCM storage, virtual filesystem runtime, parser runtime, object-store runtime, or CD runtime is claimed.

facets.F1_correctness: The plan maps WorkAreaTree work_area_hash/root/node identities to deterministic MaterializedPathEntry records and back to result_work_area_hash through an overlay journal.
facets.F2_tests: Verification is JSON syntax plus structural assertions over deterministic steps, reversibility invariants, acceptance fixtures, root-hub pointer, and artifact registry row.
facets.F3_maintainability: The artifact is machine-readable, metadata-only, and names future implementation slices instead of mixing runtime code into the design spike.
facets.F4_compatibility: The seam consumes existing WorkAreaTree, work-area hash, object-store-kernel, and scm-facts interfaces without changing their Rust APIs.
facets.F7_operability: The plan records forbidden ambient inputs, generated-output refusal, and host-path exclusion so future runtime/gates can fail closed.
facets.F10_reversibility: Every materialized entry requires reverse_mapping_ref; untouched views preserve the base hash, and authored overlays emit roundtrip evidence.
facets.F13_migration: Bridge adapters are allowed only as transitional parity evidence while native SCM/runtime cutover remains ADR-0510/ADR-0518 gated.
